CA.rationale: A content (red) and a processing condition (command_estimate) are explicitly bound to the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red), its presentation/provenance (origin), and the separate status relationship are all given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('command_estimate') is explicitly linked to the same content (red) for the candidate referent/time.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists represented content positions and color attributes for named referents/times.

D.rationale: Content identity (positions/colors) and a separate presentation/provenance/status field (origin) are both provided for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how content is organized (grid orientation) and includes per-referent origin/presentation metadata.
